text:
owen: Quick one 0 I cleaned up my personal Notion and made a 'first-week checklist' for new PMs. Where should this live so others can find/use it?

devex-bot: Tip: canonical onboarding artifacts live in team spaces or in the Onboarding DB so search + dashboards pick them up. See internal guide: https://redwood.docs/notion-onboarding

frank: We keep checklists in Product > New Hires > Checklists (DB). If you want it to show in the team nav move the page into that DB or create a DB-template entry.

owen: I can move it, but I don't see the DB in the sidebar. Is that a perms thing?

docs-admin: Likely perms. Quick steps I use: 
1) Share the page with "docs-admin" or any Product admin so we can move it for you.
2) If you can edit the target DB: Open DB > New > Templates > + > "Create template from page" and paste content.
3) If you can't edit the DB: move the page to Product > Team Drafts and file a template request (https://redwood.workflows/perm-request) with link + desired template name.

docs-admin: Naming convention: Template: <Role> - <Purpose> - YYYYMM (e.g., "Template: PM - FirstWeekChecklist - 202603"). Add tags at the top: onboarding, first-week, product. Also add frontmatter fields (plain text block): Owner: <name>; Role: PM; Audience: NewHire; LastReviewed: YYYY-MM-DD.

sophie: If the checklist references internal runbooks or secrets, mark pages as "sensitive" and don't add to public templates. Use the secure-template flow instead and ping @sophie for guest access reviews.

frank: If you want it to appear in the quick-start carousel, mention "add-to-carousel" in the template request. We review weekly on Fridays. :calendar: 

owen: Thanks. Can you move it for me, @docs-admin? I just shared the page.

docs-admin: Got it, moving now. I'll also add the frontmatter and create the DB template. Will ping when done. :white_check_mark:

owen: Awesome, really appreciate it!
